WITH latest_snapshot AS ( SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date, '%Y') AS period_name, DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') AS period_name,
MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date FROM fortune_balance_snapshot WHERE deleted = 0 AND group_id = #{groupId}
AND snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 YEAR) AND snapshot_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY period_name ) SELECT ls.period_name AS name, MAX(s.net_assets) AS value FROM latest_snapshot ls INNER JOIN fortune_balance_snapshot s ON s.group_id = #{groupId} AND s.snapshot_date = ls.latest_date AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ls.period_name ORDER BY ls.period_name ASC

WITH latest_snapshot AS ( SELECT
strftime('%Y', snapshot_date) AS period_name, strftime('%Y-%m', snapshot_date) AS period_name,
MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date FROM fortune_balance_snapshot WHERE deleted = 0 AND group_id = #{groupId}
AND snapshot_date >= date('now', '-5 year') AND snapshot_date >= date('now', '-12 month')
GROUP BY period_name ) SELECT ls.period_name AS name, MAX(s.net_assets) AS value FROM latest_snapshot ls INNER JOIN fortune_balance_snapshot s ON s.group_id = #{groupId} AND s.snapshot_date = ls.latest_date AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ls.period_name ORDER BY ls.period_name ASC
